```{r}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
setwd(home)

# Import datasets
blastResults <- read_excel("data/20210605-cgigas-roslin-mito-blastx_unfolded.xlsx", sheet = "data", col_names = TRUE)
DMLmRNA      <- read_excel("data/2021-06-21-DML-mRNA_unfolded.xlsx", sheet = "data", col_names = TRUE)

blastResults <- blastResults %>% mutate(Genbank = as.character(Genbank))
DMLmRNA      <- DMLmRNA %>% mutate(Genbank = as.character(Genbank))

# Merge files together, using Genbank ID
mRNADMLblast <- right_join.data.frame(x = blastResults , y = DMLmRNA , by = "Genbank", keep = TRUE)
# head(mRNADMLblast) #Confirm merge

# Save the newly created database in the data folder
# openxlsx::write.xlsx(x = mRNADMLblast, "data/2021-06-21-mRNA-DML-Uniprot.xlsx", sheetName = "data", col.names = TRUE, append = FALSE) #Write out file

```
